headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: TN signs 112 investment pacts worth Rs 1.15 lakh crore; aims at 1.33 lakh jobs.
NDA will win all panchayats in upcoming polls, says TDP leader Divakar Reddy in Tirupati.
NZ reach 119/2 at stumps; India declare at 720/9, highest team total.
bullets_ur: TN ne 1.15 lakh crore rupay ke 112 investment muahidon par dastakhat kiye; 1.33 lakh nokriyon ka hadaf hai.
NDA aane waley intikhabat mein tamam panchayatein jeet jaye gi, TDP rahnuma Divakar Reddy ka Tirupati mein bayan
NZ stumps tak 119/2 par pohch gayi; India ne 720/9 par inings declare kar di, jo sab se bara team total hai.
